t: This is the setting for Thomas Goode, a china, silverware and glass shop that began at 19 South Audley Street in Mayfair and later moved to 66 and 67 Burlington Arcade, Piccadilly. It held two royal warrants, one from Queen Elizabeth II and one from the Prince of Wales. Rumi Verjee, a businessman, philanthropist and Liberal Democrat member of the House of Lords, once owned it. Born in Uganda, he came to Britain as a child.
